title: 🛹 Skating is Finally a ‘Real’ Sport
text:
Skateboarding was considered a strange and childish phenomenon for much of its existence. Congregating youths and noise created many a local legislative wars waged by annoyed residents, skating bans were common and urban designers started to make outside spaces less skate-able.
The Times-News Twin Falls, Idaho 14 May 2005

In 2021 skateboarding has finally been christened a ‘real’ sport thanks to its inclusion in the Olympic Games, but even still anti-Skateboarding posters appeared around Tokyo. 

The News and Observer, April 10th 1978
